title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Add the Description 2 field to various pages to gain more insight (planning, routing, production order creation, and related processes)
summary: The Description 2 field is now available for personalization on multiple pages in Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28), including production planning, routing, and production order creation pages. This field allows users to customize their workspace and display additional information across related manufacturing and planning processes.
key_points: Description 2 field added at table level and supported across planning, routing, and production order workflows
Available for personalization on 17 pages including Production BOM Lines, Routing Lines, and Prod. Order Components
Continues Microsoft's pattern of adding personalizable fields in major updates to improve data visibility
Users can customize their workspace to display additional insight without page extensions

objects.name: Prod. BOM Mat. per Ver. Matrix

quotes.text: The Description 2 field is added at the table level, and is fully supported in planning, routing, production order creation, and related processes.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the scope and architectural foundation of where the new field is available, helping users understand its integration across manufacturing workflows.
